accepted.reason: zip_add_file() allocates deflateBound(len) bytes for raw deflate output, where len is the strlen of an XML part (or the PNG byte count). The buffer holds binary compressed data, never the source string plus a NUL, so there is no off-by-one. deflate() must now return Z_STREAM_END or the entry is refused, so an undersized buffer could not go unnoticed either.

The tool is by design a SQLite-backed package report database built from the public scan .prn files committed to this repository. It holds no credentials or personal data; the plaintext SQLite file is the product.

hard_fixes.fix: Added null-check on fopen result before fclose to avoid passing NULL to fclose when /tmp/test_empty.prn cannot be created.

--db/--import/--report/--chart-png go through secure_cli_path(): the path is rebuilt from an allowed-character table ([A-Za-z0-9/._-+~@:,]) and a '..' component is refused with a clear message. test/run_tests.sh now passes an absolute scans path. The report-in-directory path and each import path are checked for snprintf truncation (a cut-off path is no longer opened).

compute_file_sha256() streams the file through the SHA-256 block function 64 bytes at a time instead of reading up to 50 MB into memory and copying it into a padded second buffer. Verified against sha256sum (304 scan files, and edge sizes 1..100000 bytes around the 55/56/64-byte padding boundaries).

Quoted CSV fields unescape "" in place with a write pointer (was an O(n^2) memmove per quote); secure_xml_escape() writes entities from one table; parse_prn_filename() copies with snprintf("%.*s"). Old-vs-new parse of 300000 random quoted lines identical; DB dump of a full import identical.

deflate() result was ignored; a stream that did not finish would have written a truncated entry. Now requires Z_STREAM_END, sizes the buffer with deflateBound() for the raw-deflate stream, and refuses parts over 4 GiB (32-bit ZIP fields). Generated .docx contents identical.

SPECS_NEW_C/<Name>/<spec>-<UpdateAvailable>.spec used the upstream version verbatim; a '/' or '..' could leave SPECS_NEW_C if the intermediate directory existed (defense in depth: not reachable in the reproduction). Refused now; out_dir/out_path snprintf truncation checked.
Unchecked malloc before memcpy in the PCRE capture helper and split_char; PCRE2_UNSET groups now captured as empty explicitly (same result as before) instead of memcpy from s + UNSET with length 0.
Overflow-safe size arithmetic and doubling ceiling; growth sequence unchanged.
Fedora-page-derived version/release/src.rpm must be plain URL segments before being placed in the next kojipkgs URL.
Report output paths checked for snprintf truncation (three sites).
hex[128] terminated explicitly.
Buffers terminated at each step (calloc + explicit '\0'; strdup instead of copy-n+1 helpers) — cleared 14 ImproperNullTermination findings, rest are Snyk model limits.
asprintf instead of malloc+strcpy+strcat; fopen/fwrite/fclose checked; ftell < 0 handled.

Root cause of 22 ImproperNullTermination findings across check_urlhealth.c, source0_substitute.c and koji.c. The two copies are now one replace_all() with a strstr/strcasestr finder, copying byte-wise into an exactly sized buffer that is terminated once. 2,000,000 random old-vs-new cases identical.
PCRE capture copies use strndup() and check the ovector span lies inside the subject (ov[2] <= ov[3] <= length) before copying.
replace_leading_icase() and the open-vm-tools / httpd-mod_jk / <name>- prefixes use asprintf instead of hand-sized malloc+memcpy.
read() goes straight into the growable output buffer (read_append) with overflow-checked growth, instead of a stack chunk plus memcpy; empty output is still returned as NULL.
Parallel path moved to run_parallel(); one cleanup path frees clone_root/rows/prn/lut/list (was three hand-written copies).

The SPECS_NEW_C file name uses the update version only if it is rebuilt from a version-character table (letters, digits, '._+~^-') and is not '.'/'..'; the Source0 extension swap uses asprintf instead of three length-summed memcpy calls.

version/release/src.rpm from Fedora pages are rebuilt from an RPM-field character table before going into the next kojipkgs URL (was a deny-list). koji_fedora_lookup() is still not called from production code.
Loop condition carries the buffer bound (used < sizeof buf - 1) instead of a post-hoc break.
Single free(buf) on both fread outcomes (was free + goto).
The three directory arguments are rebuilt from an allowed-character table and a '..' component is refused with a clear message.

accepted.reason: SHA-1 is computed only to reproduce the '%define sha1' values Photon spec files declare (column 9 parity with the PS script); it is not used for any trust decision. SHA-256/512 are used where the spec declares them.

The taint source is default_working_dir(): $PUBLIC, else $HOME, the PS L87 default for -workingDir. Reports and SPECS_NEW_C are written under that operator-chosen directory by contract; the process's own environment is the same trust level as the -workingDir/-scansDir options (which Snyk does not flag). Restricting it would reject working directories the PS original accepts. Every derived path is checked for snprintf truncation, and the only upstream-derived file-name parts (cache name, update version) are checked separately.
